explanation: OEIS A001157, Z.-W. Sun: 'For each k = 2,3,..., all the rational numbers sigma_k(n)/n^k = Sum_{d|n} 1/d^k (n = 1,2,3,...) have pairwise distinct fractional parts.' The formal statement uses ArithmeticFunction.sigma k, divides by n^k in ℚ, and asserts distinct Int.fract for distinct positive n₁, n₂, for every k ≥ 2. Faithful.
